description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing CAPTCHA extensions within the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for listing available CAPTCHA extensions, installing and uninstalling extensions, and handling related permissions and view rendering.

classes.name: Captcha
classes.description: Controller class for managing CAPTCHA extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, providing functions to list, install, and uninstall CAPTCHA modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of CAPTCHA extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares a list of available and installed CAPTCHA extensions for display.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a CAPTCHA extension, including permission assignment and autoloader registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles removal of a CAPTCHA extension and performs related cleanup.
